# Content: the words users see

Labels, messages and vocabulary live here (DOCSPEC R11.3). One word per action, in every app.

## Action vocabulary

| Action | Word | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Save a form | Save | never "Submit" |
| Leave without saving | Cancel | |

## Retired words

A retired word is not drawn as a label, button or message. The guard scans the source for each one.

<!-- retired-words:start -->
| Retired | Use instead |
|---|---|
| Submit | Save |
| Click here | (name the action) |
<!-- retired-words:end -->
